我已经获取了所有关键信息，下面给出完整回答。

---

## 1. Intelligent Cloud 本季度收入同比增长

**计算过程：**

| 项目 | FY26 Q4（三个月截至 2026/6/30） | FY25 Q4（三个月截至 2025/6/30） |
|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 million | $29,878 million |

公式：同比增长率 = ($39,306 − $29,878) / $29,878 = $9,428 / $29,878 ≈ **31.6% → 取整为 32%**（按 GAAP 报告口径）。

按恒定汇率口径（Constant Currency）同比增长为 **31%**。

**出处**：`financial_statements.txt` / `press_release.txt` 中分部收入表（Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 vs 2025, Percentage Change Y/Y GAAP 32%, Constant Currency 31%）；`transcript.txt` 位置 24798："Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."

---

## 2. 管理层在财报电话会上的归因（原话引用）

管理层在 `transcript.txt` 位置 24798–24930 区间对 Intelligent Cloud 增长做出如下归因：

**(a) Azure 及其他云服务**（Azure 收入同比增长 43%）：
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity**. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."

**(b) GitHub Copilot**：
> "Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value**."

**(c) 本地服务器业务（On-premises server）**：
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts**."

---

## 3. 归因中"已发生事实"vs"前瞻性表述"的区分

### 已发生的事实（描述本季度已经实现的结果或已采取的行动）

| 归因 | 依据 |
|---|---|
| Azure 收入增长 43% | 是已公布的 Q4 实际数字（transcript 位置 24798） |
| Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity | 描述当前（本季度）状态，原文用现在时 "continues" |
| Efficiency gains across CPU and GPU fleet | 已实现并已反映在本季业绩中，原文为过去时态"driven by" |
| Process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity | 已在本季度发生并产生效果 |
| That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized | "in-quarter" 明确指本季度内已发生，"was quickly monetized" 为过去完成 |
| June business model change to align pricing with usage and value | 已发生的具体事件（6月已完成） |
| Stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption | 已实现的 Q4 实际消费数据 |
| On-prem server renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition | 已完成的续约及会计确认结果 |

### 前瞻性表述（管理层对未来的判断、展望或预期）

| 归因/表述 | 依据 |
|---|---|
| "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | 原文位置 32792，明确使用 "continue to expect" 指向未来（H1 FY27） |
| "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | "remain focused on delivering" 表示未来将持续进行的努力；"the gaps we see" 为管理层对未来供需缺口的预判 |
| "year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter based on capacity timing and contract mix" | 原文位置 32792，明确是对未来季度波动性的风险提示 |
| FY27 Q1 Azure 增长"approximately 45% in constant currency"的指引 | 原文位置 32535，"we expect" 为明确的前瞻性指引 |
| "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | 未来半年的增长预期 |

### 区分方法说明

我主要依据以下三条标准进行区分：
1. **时态**：过去时/完成时（"grew", "was", "were driven", "was quickly monetized"）→ 已发生事实；将来时/情态动词（"expect", "remain focused on", "will"）→ 前瞻性表述。
2. **是否附含预测性词汇**：出现 "expect", "continue to expect", "remain focused on", "we see", "can vary" 等词汇的为前瞻性。
3. **是否涉及尚未发生的期间**：提及"本季度（in-quarter）""6月变更（June business model change）"为已发生；提及"即将到来的季度""H1""未来 capacity timing"为前瞻。

值得注意的是，"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" 这句话本身用现在时描述当前状态，属于已发生事实；但同一语境下管理层接下去说的"the gaps we see"以及"bridge the gaps"则是基于这一现状对未来的前瞻性判断——需要在引用时按具体句子逐句区分，不可笼统归为一类。
